The '''Chancellor's guard''' was a position created for the protection of the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and were to guard and preserve their life. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Johun Othone]] once served at this position in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], protecting [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]], the chancellor at the time.
